output.subject: Your question about linking your savings and checking accounts
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch with us, and for thinking ahead. We have received your message and want to confirm what you asked so you know it has been read carefully.

You asked whether your savings account can be linked to your checking account so that, if your checking balance goes negative, money is drawn from savings rather than your account going into overdraft. You also asked whether there is a fee for setting this up. You mentioned that you would prefer to arrange it now, before anything happens, rather than wait until it is needed.

Those are sensible questions, and we want to make sure you get accurate, complete answers. A specialist team is reviewing your question and will respond to you within 10 business days with the information you asked for.

If anything changes in the meantime, or you have more questions you would like us to cover in that reply, please let us know and we will add them.

Thank you again for reaching out to us.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a question, not a complaint; the draft avoids complaint language.
Confirm whether a savings-to-checking overdraft transfer link is available on this customer's accounts.
Confirm whether any fee applies to the service or to each transfer, and state it accurately.
Decide whether to explain how the customer can set it up (branch, online, phone) in the final reply.
Consider whether a faster answer than 10 business days is appropriate for a simple product question.
